messages.content:
<profile>
Sells: Northpaw Dog Supply sells walking gear for dogs, including a front-clip no-pull harness, a 6 ft biothane leash, a 30 ft training long line and a rechargeable LED collar light. It also sells beds and blankets, namely a memory foam dog bed with a removable cover and a machine-washable fleece dog blanket.
Audience: Dog owners who walk and train their dogs, including those dealing with leash pulling or walking in low light, and who want a comfortable bed or blanket for their dog at home.
Country: US
Tone: friendly
Never say: —
</profile>

<products>
<group name="Bed">
  P1: Memory Foam Dog Bed
    - The Memory Foam Dog Bed is made by Northpaw.
    - The Memory Foam Dog Bed is available in sizes M and L.
    - The Memory Foam Dog Bed has 4 in of memory foam on a 1 in support base.
    - The Memory Foam Dog Bed has a removable cover.
    - The Memory Foam Dog Bed's cover is machine washable at 40 °C.
    - The Memory Foam Dog Bed has a water-resistant liner.
    - The Memory Foam Dog Bed has a non-slip bottom.
    - The Memory Foam Dog Bed in size M measures 30 × 20 in.
    - The Memory Foam Dog Bed in size L measures 40 × 28 in.
</group>
<group name="Blanket">
  P2: Fleece Dog Blanket
    - The Fleece Dog Blanket is made of double-layer polar fleece.
    - The Fleece Dog Blanket measures 40 × 30 in.
    - The Fleece Dog Blanket is machine washable.
    - The Fleece Dog Blanket can be tumble dried on low.
    - The Fleece Dog Blanket fits in the car boot or on the sofa.
    - The Fleece Dog Blanket is made by Northpaw.
</group>
<group name="Harness">
  P3: Front-Clip No-Pull Harness
    - The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness is a harness.
    - The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness is made by Northpaw.
    - The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness is available in sizes XS, S, M, L, and XL.
    - The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness has a leash ring on the chest that turns the dog sideways when it pulls.
    - The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness has four adjustment points.
    - The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness has a padded neoprene chest plate.
    - The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness has reflective stitching.
    - The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness fits a chest girth of 13–42 in across sizes XS to XL.
</group>
<group name="Leash">
  P4: Biothane Leash, 6 ft
    - The Biothane Leash is 6 ft long.
    - The Biothane Leash is made of coated webbing that does not absorb water or smell.
    - The Biothane Leash is 5/8 in wide.
    - The Biothane Leash has a brass snap hook.
    - The Biothane Leash can be wiped clean.
    - The Biothane Leash has a breaking strength of 600 lb.
    - The Biothane Leash is made by Northpaw.
  P5: Training Long Line, 30 ft
    - The Training Long Line is 30 ft long.
    - The Training Long Line is a leash.
    - The Training Long Line is made by Northpaw.
    - The Training Long Line is made of lightweight biothane.
    - The Training Long Line is intended for recall practice.
    - The Training Long Line has no handle loop.
    - The Training Long Line floats in water.
    - The Training Long Line has a stainless steel swivel clip.
</group>
<group name="Light">
  P6: Rechargeable LED Collar Light
    - The Rechargeable LED Collar Light clips onto any collar or harness.
    - The Rechargeable LED Collar Light has three modes: steady, slow flash, and fast flash.
    - The Rechargeable LED Collar Light is visible from about 1,000 ft.
    - The Rechargeable LED Collar Light charges via USB-C.
    - The Rechargeable LED Collar Light runs for 6 hours on steady mode.
    - The Rechargeable LED Collar Light is rated IPX7 waterproof.
    - The Rechargeable LED Collar Light is made by Northpaw.
    - The Rechargeable LED Collar Light is rechargeable.
</group>
</products>

</already_covered>
